description: Move agent skill definitions from static VM files to the database, syncing them dynamically so users can manage and add custom skills via the UI without restarting OpenClaw.

context.currentProblem: Agent skills are hardcoded as static markdown files built into the Docker image. Users cannot dynamically create, edit, or delete skills without a new Docker build.
context.desiredState: Skills are managed in a Supabase database table. The agent-api acts as a bridge, syncing skills from the database to the VM's disk so OpenClaw's native file watcher can load them dynamically.
context.architectureGoal: Do not modify OpenClaw's core skill loading logic. Use a Hybrid Sync approach where the database is the master record, and the file system acts as a mirror for OpenClaw to read.

userStories.title: Create Supabase skills table and migration
userStories.description: As a developer, I need a database table to store skill definitions (name, description, markdown_content, agent_key) so that they can be dynamically managed.
acceptanceCriteria: Create migration file for `agent_skills` table
Table includes columns: id, user_id, agent_key, name, description, markdown_content
RLS policies set up for user isolation
TypeScript compiles without errors
userStories.notes: Ensure it links properly to the auth.users table.

userStories.title: Build API endpoints for skill sync
userStories.description: As the agent VM, I need an API endpoint in agent-api to fetch the latest skills for my assigned agents so I can write them to disk.
acceptanceCriteria: Create GET /skills sync endpoint in agent-api
Endpoint fetches skills from Supabase for the current user's agents
Creates nested folders and writes SKILL.md files to /app/agents/[agent_key]/skills/
TypeScript compiles without errors
userStories.notes: Must handle creating directories if they don't exist using fs.promises.

userStories.title: Trigger sync on VM startup
userStories.description: As the agent VM, I need to sync skills immediately when I boot up so I have the latest instructions before handling messages.
acceptanceCriteria: Update the agent-api startup sequence (e.g. start.sh or main bootstrap) to call the sync logic
Verify skills are written to disk before OpenClaw begins processing
TypeScript compiles without errors
userStories.notes: Can hook into the existing bootstrap process in agent-api.

userStories.title: Create webhook to trigger live sync
userStories.description: As a user, I want my agents to learn new skills immediately after I save them in the UI, without restarting the VM.
acceptanceCriteria: Create POST /skills/sync endpoint to manually trigger a sync
Setup Supabase webhook (or trigger from frontend API) to call this endpoint when skills change
Verify OpenClaw's chokidar file watcher detects the new SKILL.md files automatically
TypeScript compiles without errors
userStories.notes: OpenClaw already watches the skills folder, so just writing the file is enough to trigger a refresh.

userStories.title: Build Skills Management UI
userStories.description: As a user, I need a UI in Mission Control to view, edit, and create custom skills for my agents.
acceptanceCriteria: Add 'Manage Skills' modal/page to the Team dashboard
Form to create a new skill with name, description, and markdown editor for instructions
List view of existing skills per agent
Verify in browser that skills can be saved and updated
TypeScript compiles without errors
userStories.notes: Can use existing UI components from the app.

visualVerification.lookFor: New Skills Management interface accessible from the agent card
